question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Alluring
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"alluring"** means something that is **very attractive or tempting.** (आकर्षक)

 
 
• **Example:** The actress had an alluring charm that captivated everyone who met her.
 
 
 
• **"Repulsive"** refers to something that is extremely **unpleasant or disgusting; it drives people away**. (घृणित)
 
 
• **Example:** The smell from the garbage was so repulsive that people had to cover their noses.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'alluring'** is **'repulsive'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Enticing** (लुभावना): Something that is attractive or tempting.

 
 
• **Example:** The job offer was** enticing** because of the high salary and benefits.
 
 
 
• **Fascinating** (मनमोहक): Extremely interesting or charming.
 
 
• **Example:** The documentary on marine life was absolutely **fascinating.**
 
 
 
• **Glamorous** (ग्लैमरस): Full of charm and elegance.
 
 
• **Example:** She looked **glamorous** in her evening gown at the awards ceremony.
